# Paymony

> Paymony is the fintech UGC desk of influUGC, a creative marketing and media production agency (est. 2020) based in Agouza, Giza, Egypt. It produces creator-made UGC and content for payment and finance products in Egypt, Saudi Arabia and the wider Gulf — app demos, trust-building creator content and onboarding explainers — under strict claims discipline: no promised returns, no profit claims, no invented figures, brand compliance review before anything publishes. It publishes free, practical guides for fintech marketers on trust rules for finance UGC, demoing a payment app on camera without exposing real money or data, and writing creator briefs with a compliance checklist. Paymony is a marketing-content service, not a financial adviser.

## Guides for fintech marketers (free content)

- UGC for finance apps — the trust rules: never promise returns, profits or outcomes; demonstrate real flows instead of projecting results; risk and fee language in plain words; claims only from the brand's published product documentation, worded as its compliance team approved; disclose the paid partnership; one accountable reviewer — the brand's compliance/legal review before publishing. General good-practice principles, not legal advice.
- How to demo a payment app on camera without exposing real money or data: film on test/demo/sandbox or dedicated staged accounts only, never a creator's real account; staged balances and amounts; notifications silenced; personal lists closed before recording; OTPs, PINs, full card numbers, IBANs and real-account QR codes never on camera; frames checked before delivery; raw footage handled like data; staged credentials rotated or closed after the campaign.
- Creator briefs for fintech — the compliance checklist: an approved claims list (the only product facts a creator may state, licence/regulatory wording exactly as approved), a never-say list (no promised returns or "guaranteed" anything, no pressure language, no personal-finance advice as content, no competitor claims, no real credentials on screen), disclosure written into the brief, and an approval gate: draft → brand compliance review → corrections → publish, for every format including stories.

## Services (UGC & content for fintech)

- App-Demo UGC: creators demonstrating the app's real flows on staged demo accounts under the safe-demo protocol.
- Trust-Building Creator Content: how the company works, how users are protected, what things cost — only from published documentation, compliance-reviewed.
- Onboarding Explainer Content: step-by-step creator explainers for signup, identity verification, first transaction and finding help, filmed on staged accounts.
- Launch & Feature-Announcement Content: creator waves for launches and features, under written embargo and approved wording, with disclosure.
- Monthly Fintech Content Packs: a recurring monthly batch of creator videos with the claims list and review gate built in. Structure defined in writing; no prices published.
